; openremark — Ask and Haiku buttons (reMarkable 2).
; DocumentView selector from rmitchellscott/xovi-qmd-extensions (GPL-3.0-only).
AFFECT [[1224665461898798997]]
    IMPORT QtQuick 2.15
    IMPORT net.asivery.XoviMessageBroker 2.0
    TRAVERSE [[8397993708429497603]]#[[6504254477]]
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            Rectangle {
                id: inkDiaryControl
                z: 10000
                // Framed button centred in the toolbar cell under the close button (rM2
                // portrait toolbar: 112 px cells). diary.cpp masks this rect out of
                // the page capture.
                anchors.right: parent.right
                anchors.top: parent.top
                anchors.topMargin: 138
                anchors.rightMargin: 26
                width: 60
                height: 60
                color: "white"
                border.color: "black"
                border.width: 2
                radius: 6
                property bool diaryBusy: false
                property string diaryMessage: "Ask"
                property bool diaryError: false
                XoviMessageBroker { id: inkDiaryBroker }
                Image {
                    anchors.centerIn: parent
                    width: 44
                    height: 44
                    source: "file:///home/root/.config/ink-diary/ask.svg"
                    sourceSize.width: 44
                    sourceSize.height: 44
                    visible: !inkDiaryControl.diaryBusy
                }
                Rectangle {
                    anchors.centerIn: parent
                    width: 26
                    height: 26
                    color: "black"
                    visible: inkDiaryControl.diaryBusy
                }
                Rectangle {
                    anchors.right: parent.right
                    anchors.top: parent.bottom
                    anchors.topMargin: 8
                    anchors.rightMargin: 12
                    width: 450
                    height: statusText.implicitHeight + 28
                    color: "white"
                    border.color: "black"
                    border.width: 2
                    radius: 8
                    visible: (statusTimer.running || inkDiaryControl.diaryError) && !inkDiaryControl.diaryBusy
                    Text {
                        id: statusText
                        anchors.left: parent.left
                        anchors.right: parent.right
                        anchors.top: parent.top
                        anchors.margins: 14
                        text: inkDiaryControl.diaryMessage
                        font.pixelSize: 24
                        wrapMode: Text.WordWrap
                        color: "black"
                    }
                }
                Timer { id: statusTimer; interval: 5000 }
                MouseArea {
                    anchors.fill: parent
                    onPressAndHold: statusTimer.restart()
                    onClicked: {
                        statusTimer.stop();
                        if (inkDiaryControl.diaryBusy) {
                            inkDiaryBroker.sendSimpleSignal("ink-diary$cancel", "");
                        } else {
                            inkDiaryControl.diaryBusy = true;
                            inkDiaryBroker.sendSimpleSignal("ink-diary$start", "");
                        }
                    }
                }
                Timer {
                    interval: 500
                    repeat: true
                    running: inkDiaryControl.visible
                    onTriggered: {
                        try {
                            var result = JSON.parse(inkDiaryBroker.sendSimpleSignal("ink-diary$status", ""));
                            if (inkDiaryControl.diaryBusy && !result.busy) statusTimer.restart();
                            inkDiaryControl.diaryBusy = result.busy;
                            inkDiaryControl.diaryMessage = result.message;
                            inkDiaryControl.diaryError = result.error === true;
                        } catch (error) {
                            inkDiaryControl.diaryBusy = false;
                            inkDiaryControl.diaryMessage = "Ink Diary extension unavailable";
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            Rectangle {
                id: inkDiaryPremium
                z: 10000
                // Second button, one toolbar cell below Ask: the same request with
                // premium_model (Haiku). diary.cpp masks this rect out of the capture too.
                anchors.right: parent.right
                anchors.top: parent.top
                anchors.topMargin: 250
                anchors.rightMargin: 26
                width: 60
                height: 60
                color: "white"
                border.color: "black"
                border.width: 2
                radius: 6
                Image {
                    anchors.centerIn: parent
                    width: 40
                    height: 40
                    source: "file:///home/root/.config/ink-diary/ask-haiku.svg"
                    sourceSize.width: 40
                    sourceSize.height: 40
                    visible: !inkDiaryControl.diaryBusy
                }
                Rectangle {
                    anchors.centerIn: parent
                    width: 26
                    height: 26
                    color: "black"
                    visible: inkDiaryControl.diaryBusy
                }
                MouseArea {
                    anchors.fill: parent
                    onPressAndHold: statusTimer.restart()
                    onClicked: {
                        statusTimer.stop();
                        if (inkDiaryControl.diaryBusy) {
                            inkDiaryBroker.sendSimpleSignal("ink-diary$cancel", "");
                        } else {
                            inkDiaryControl.diaryBusy = true;
                            inkDiaryBroker.sendSimpleSignal("ink-diary$start", "premium");
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            Rectangle {
                id: inkDiaryTools
                z: 10000
                // Third button, one toolbar cell below Haiku: the same request through the
                // MCP proxy at tools_base_url. diary.cpp masks this rect out of the capture too.
                anchors.right: parent.right
                anchors.top: parent.top
                anchors.topMargin: 362
                anchors.rightMargin: 26
                width: 60
                height: 60
                color: "white"
                border.color: "black"
                border.width: 2
                radius: 6
                Image {
                    anchors.centerIn: parent
                    width: 40
                    height: 40
                    source: "file:///home/root/.config/ink-diary/ask-tools.svg"
                    sourceSize.width: 40
                    sourceSize.height: 40
                    visible: !inkDiaryControl.diaryBusy
                }
                Rectangle {
                    anchors.centerIn: parent
                    width: 26
                    height: 26
                    color: "black"
                    visible: inkDiaryControl.diaryBusy
                }
                MouseArea {
                    anchors.fill: parent
                    onPressAndHold: statusTimer.restart()
                    onClicked: {
                        statusTimer.stop();
                        if (inkDiaryControl.diaryBusy) {
                            inkDiaryBroker.sendSimpleSignal("ink-diary$cancel", "");
                        } else {
                            inkDiaryControl.diaryBusy = true;
                            inkDiaryBroker.sendSimpleSignal("ink-diary$start", "tools");
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
